subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear John, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on August 15th, 2022, at 10:00 AM. Your booking reference number is XY1234. Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure for check-in. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to contact us. Have a pleasant journey! Regards, XYZ Airlines
